subject: [hw] opus-hevcdec -> DEC01/DEC05/dec1: START data[0]/data[1] are swapped in dec1/vdec_ref.c (bytesused first)
body:
Bug found while bringing up HEVC; affects every client copied from dec1/vdec_ref.c.

Kernel: vdec_common_if.c:267-268 sends data[0] = bs->size, data[1] = bs->length, and mtk_vcodec_dec.c:670-671 sets buf->size = planes[0].bytesused (the AU) and buf->length = planes[0].length (buffer size). dec1/vdec_ref.c start_au() sends { DEC_START, vcu_inst, bss.bytes (1 MiB buffer), n (AU), 0, 0 } = swapped.

Effect [V, host run]: vpud logs '[Err] flush size 1048581 (1048576+5) out of range 4437' every START and sets the VLD vfifo end at the buffer end. H.264 survives. HEVC searches the next picture start in the stale bytes after the AU, re-decodes old slices and answers VDEC_NEED_MORE_OUTPUT_BUF (vsi.dec.changed bit 4) every other START, display order wrong. With data[0]=AU length, data[1]=buffer size: 12/12 and 6/6 HEVC pictures in ffprobe display order, 0 NEED_MORE_OUTPUT.

Fix: uint32_t st[6] = { DEC_START, vcu_inst, (uint32_t)n, bss[bi].bytes, 0, 0 }. Also implement VDEC_NEED_MORE_OUTPUT_BUF like the kernel (mtk_vcodec_dec.c:710-790: keep the source buffer, decode it again with the next capture buffer). Both are in gpu/hwcodec/fakevdec_hevc/vdec_hevc_ref.c (new file; I did not edit dec1/). Please apply to ap/n2ap_vdec.c and the DEC05 service. Host only, nothing on the phone.
